subject.title: fix: report unavailable Codex runtime in model status

question: Should this PR intentionally change `models status --check` to fail whenever the selected Codex harness plugin is unavailable, and should release owners add any resulting changelog note separately?
rationale: The patch changes a documented CLI health-check exit contract and also includes release-owned content; policy and contributor tests cannot determine the intended release/operator compatibility decision.

options.title: Confirm and land the CLI contract
options.body: Accept a nonzero `--check` result for unavailable selected harness plugins as the intended correction to false-healthy status output, after removing the branch changelog edit.

options.title: Narrow the status semantics
options.body: Keep the additional diagnostics but preserve the previous check exit behavior until a separately approved compatibility plan is available.

recommendation.title: Confirm and land the CLI contract
recommendation.body: Accept a nonzero `--check` result for unavailable selected harness plugins as the intended correction to false-healthy status output, after removing the branch changelog edit.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Codex runtime-policy history makes this the strongest available routing candidate for the health-check semantics.
